thread:
lauren: FYI - noticed an SDK breaking change landed in the v2 client that will affect some of our migration guides. It's the param rename from `max_tokens` -> `max_tokens_per_response` and a model embed-dim change that can surface subtle failures. Need a small canary plan and docs PR triage.

sanjay: Oof, thanks for flagging. Do we have a list of affected snippets?

lauren: Quick scan: quickstart, streaming examples, and ruby/js embed samples. Also a few code blocks in the migration guide assume the old name.

maya: I can do a targeted search/grep across docs repo and open a PR with replacements + compatibility notes. Suggest we add an official compatibility snippet showing the alias shim: `params.max_tokens_per_response ||= params.max_tokens` as a short-term pattern.

chris: +1 on alias shim. But we should surface the behavioral change too — some users hit truncated responses if they relied on previous default semantics. Can we add a small FAQ entry?

lauren: Good call. Action list: 1) smoke-search for old param in docs + examples, 2) update quickstart + migration guide with alias example and FAQ, 3) create a canary rollout for the SDK change and capture errors.

maya: I'll do 1 & 2. Opening a PR shortly: #4821 (WIP) — will add reviewers @sanjay @chris.

sanjay: For the canary, infra suggests: route 1% of CI traffic to v2 SDK builds that include the rename. We should have log hooks for parameter mismatch warnings. I can coordinate with eng-infra.

lauren: Perfect. Can we also add a short smoke test in docs CI that runs the quickstart snippet and asserts the key fields exist? Helps catch future regressions.

chris: I can author the smoke test. Plan: run quickstart with known prompt, assert response not truncated and that the request uses `max_tokens_per_response` in the payload. Will add to docs/ci/smoke_tests.md.

maya: PR #4821 now has the textual fixes and a `compatibility.md` section. Still need to wire the code alias snippet in language-specific examples.

lauren: Great — for language snippets, keep them minimal. Example proposals: JS: `options.max_tokens_per_response = options.max_tokens_per_response ?? options.max_tokens` ; Ruby: `opts[:max_tokens_per_response] ||= opts[:max_tokens]` ; Go: short one-liner too.

docs-bot: Reminder — please add the `docs-update` label to the PR and include changelog entry per docs playbook.

maya: Added label and changelog blurb. @sanjay any ETA on the canary routing?

sanjay: I'll put a ticket in eng-infra this afternoon. ETA for config: ~36 hours. Will post the canary route and alert hooks here when ready.

chris: Once canary is live, I'll run the smoke test repeatedly for a couple of hours and grab any failed traces. If anything odd shows up, we gate the rollout.

lauren: Thanks team. After canary and docs PR merged, we should schedule a short customer comms blurb (gentle heads-up) and add deprecation note to v1 -> v2 migration guide with concrete remediation steps.

maya: Adding a deprecation snippet now. Will tag you for final review, lauren.

sanjay: Filed infra ticket: I-2026-137. Will update this thread when routing is live.

lauren: Filing the final checklist here so we don't lose it: `todo: search + PR (maya)`, `canary routing + alerts (sanjay)`, `smoke tests (chris)`, `customer comms + migration note (lauren)`. Marking low-risk but high-visibility. :white_check_mark:

chris: Noted. I'll push the smoke test branch to my fork and link once ready.

maya: PR #4821 ready for review — folks, please skim the compatibility.md section and the language snippets. I'm going to land the trivial textual fixes once reviewers sign off.

lauren: Thanks. If reviewers approve, aim to merge after canary is configured. We'll coordinate the announcement afterward.

sanjay: Canary config posted: https://internal.redwood/infra/canaries/I-2026-137 — routing at 1% for next 48h.

chris: Running first smoke run now.

chris: (results) no truncation, alias header present in payload, no errors in traces after 2 runs.

lauren: Excellent. Unless anything unexpected pops up, go ahead and merge the docs PR and we roll the SDK change to broader traffic.

maya: Merged #4821. Documentation patches live.

docs-bot: PR #4821 merged by maya. Changelog entry created: "SDK param rename: max_tokens -> max_tokens_per_response; compatibility notes added."

lauren: Closing loop — migration note updated, canary successful, smoke tests green. I'll draft the short customer-facing note tomorrow and share for sign-off. Thanks all!
